ext_name.message: IndiMasq: Indian PII shield for AI chats

ext_description.message: Warns before you send or attach Aadhaar, PAN, UPI, bank or phone details on ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, and masks them. On-device.

banner_body.message: Mask replaces them with placeholders like [PAN_1] before anything leaves your browser.

notice_masked.message: Masked. Check the message, then send it.

masked_note.message: (IndiMasq: values in [brackets] are hidden personal details. Keep them as they are.)

notice_redacted.message: Attached a copy with the personal details replaced. Check it before sending.

popup_tagline.message: Indian PII shield for AI chats

popup_restore_hint.message: Point at a placeholder like [PAN_1] in the chat to see its real value. It is shown only to you; the chat page and the AI never get it.

popup_privacy.message: Runs entirely on your device. IndiMasq never sends your messages anywhere, and stores only these counts.

popup_limits.message: IndiMasq reduces risk; it can miss things. Check before you send.

popup_chat_hint.message: Kept only in this tab's memory. Gone when you close or reload the tab.

notice_checking_file.message: IndiMasq is checking the file on your device…

notice_file_clean.message: IndiMasq checked the file: no personal details found.

notice_file_failed.message: IndiMasq could not read this file, so it was not checked.

banner_file_body.message: IndiMasq can attach a copy with them replaced by placeholders like [PAN_1]. The AI never sees the real values. A PDF copy is made of page pictures, so its text cannot be selected.

notice_redact_failed.message: IndiMasq could not make a safe copy, so nothing was attached.

popup_files_hint.message: Reads text, Word and PDF files on your device to find Aadhaar, PAN and other details.

problem_locked.message: "$NAME$" is locked with a password, so IndiMasq could not check it.

problem_too_long.message: "$NAME$" is too long for IndiMasq to check (more than 30 pages).

problem_damaged.message: IndiMasq could not open "$NAME$" to check it.

problem_no_text.message: "$NAME$" has no readable text (it may be scanned), so IndiMasq could not check it.

problem_body.message: If it holds personal details such as an Aadhaar card or a bank statement, think twice before sharing it with the AI.

note_pages_unchecked.message: Pages $PAGES$ are scanned pictures and were not checked.
